cutList.derivation: Plan axes x = length, y = width: 36" x 1024 = 36864 long, 12" x 1024 = 12288 wide, 3/4" plywood's 3/4" (the depth, 768) thick. Texts: 36 = 3 x 12 -> 3'-0"; 12 -> 1'-0". Largest piece, so first.

cutList.label: Leg
cuts: Mitre the west end: from 7/16" in along the south edge to the north-west corner (≈16.5° off square).
Mitre the east end: from 7/16" in along the north edge to the south-east corner (≈16.5° off square).
cutList.derivation: Each leg runs 7" out (Y) and 24" up (Z): d = (0, 7, 24) in, 7^2 + 24^2 = 625 = 25^2, so the centreline is 25" = 25600 exactly. Reference Z, local Z = d x Z = (7, 0, 0): the floor and seat cuts are plain mitres in the wide face. Setback = 1 1/2 x 7 / 24 = 7/16" = 448 exactly (1536 x 7 = 10752 = 24 x 448). Long point L = 25 + (7/16 + 7/16)/2 = 25 7/16" = 26048, exact, so no approximately-sign. 25 7/16 = 2 x 12 + 1 7/16 -> 2'-1 7/16". 2x2 is 1 1/2" x 1 1/2" (PS 20-25 Table 3, dry). The four legs are mirror images; mirroring a component of d changes no norm and, with the frame oriented d.Z > 0, no corner, so they are one row of 4. Label: common prefix "Leg, " cut to "Leg". Sentences (shaped-parts 4.4): the south-west cut takes 7/16" along the south edge and the whole 1 1/2" west end: a mitre of the west end to the north-west corner; the north-east cut is its twin at the east end, a parallelogram. atan(7/24) = 16.26 degrees -> nearest half degree 16.5, not 45 so marked.
